papers.title_en: Looking Around by Looking Around: Omnidirectional Gaze-based VR Viewport Control
papers.authors: Hock Siang Lee, Jinghui Hu, Florian Weidner, Haopeng Wang, Hans Gellersen
papers.evidence: 基于注视的VR视口控制用于免手人机交互
papers.tldr: 传统VR视口控制依赖头/躯干移动，在受限或长时间使用中费力且局限。本文提出LALA，一种基于凝视的VR俯仰偏航视口控制方法，通过眼睛运动实现无需头、手、身体移动的全向探索。针对眼动感知不对称设计非对称控制轮廓，利用眼睛停留在舒适区的倾向进行控制。用户研究（N=18）表明，LALA性能与基线相当，但用户偏好更强，实现免提低负担交互。
papers.abstract_en: Traditional VR viewport control primarily relies on head and torso movement, which can be effortful and limiting in both constrained and extended-use settings. We introduce Looking Around by Looking Around (LALA), a gaze-based VR pitch-and-yaw viewport control technique designed for natural and effortless omnidirectional exploration via eye movements, without requiring or obstructing movement of the head, hand, or body, offering a low-effort and highly accessible interaction method. Because gaze is primarily used for perception and exhibits oculomotor and perceptual asymmetries, using it directly for control is difficult. To address this, we designed an asymmetric omnidirectional control profile for the eye, then built on it to exploit tendencies for eyes to stay within comfortable regions for viewport control. We evaluated LALA in a user study (N=18) featuring two contrasting tasks: alignment towards known directions and open-ended visual search towards unknown directions. LALA was strongly preferred over the traditional baseline, achieving competitive performance while enabling fully hands-free interaction with minimal physical movement.

papers.title_en: An Eye-Tracking Dataset for Viewing Distance Categories in Real-World Scenarios
papers.authors: Dohwa Kim, Yejin Choi, Seungbok Lee, Chi Yoon Jeong, Eunji Park
papers.evidence: 眼动追踪数据集，明确用于理解用户意图并支持距离感知交互系统
papers.tldr: 观看距离估计对理解用户意图和构建距离感知交互系统至关重要，然而现有眼动数据集多在实验室环境或静态任务中采集，难以反映真实场景中的动态观看行为。为此，我们提出GazeDepth数据集，利用可穿戴眼动追踪器记录19名参与者在固定距离（33/50/300厘米）及室内外可变距离场景下的同步注视、瞳孔、3D眼向量和头部运动信号。统计分析与分类实验表明，辐辏角等距离相关特征在不同距离类别间差异显著，能够有效区分近、中、远三类距离。GazeDepth为真实世界中基于注视的距离推断和距离感知交互提供了宝贵的数据支持。
papers.abstract_en: Estimating viewing distance from gaze behavior is essential for understanding user intent and enabling distance-aware interactive systems. However, most existing eye-tracking datasets have been collected in constrained settings, such as laboratory environments or static tasks. Consequently, they only partially capture viewing behaviors in real-world situations where viewing distance changes with natural head and body movements. We introduce GazeDepth, an eye-tracking dataset collected from 19 participants using a wearable tracker during tasks reflecting real-world scenarios. GazeDepth includes fixed-distance viewing scenarios with constant observer-target distances at near (33 cm), middle (50 cm), and far (300 cm), as well as variable-distance viewing scenarios in which participants shift gaze among targets at different depths in indoor and outdoor environments. The dataset provides synchronized gaze data, pupil size, 3D eye-vectors, and head-motion signals, along with distance labels. Statistical analyses showed that distance-related gaze features, such as vergence angle and estimated viewing distance, differed consistently across viewing-distance categories. In addition, classification models trained on GazeDepth further demonstrated that the dataset captures gaze characteristics that distinguish the three viewing-distance categories, supporting gaze-based distance inference and distance-aware interaction in realistic scenarios.

papers.title_en: Augmenting Human Performance with an XR Agent Learning from Online Behavior and BCI Evidence
papers.authors: Ziheng Li, Xichen He, Haoyan Chen, Charlie Zou, Sheng Bai, Benjamin Yang, Mengyuan Wu, Jake Ledner, Yi-Jie Cheng, Akito Yamauchi, Dishita G Turakhia, Steven Feiner, Paul Sajda
papers.evidence: 基于注视锁定脑电与行为信号的实时多模态意图辅助
papers.tldr: 高时间压力动态任务中，人类反应带宽有限，亟需实时辅助。本文提出OLIVE，在XR射击游戏中在线融合击靶行为与注视锁定EEG，无需标注即自适应调整VLM目标推断，实现实时辅助。三项用户研究证实，OLIVE在收敛率和速度上优于现有测试时适应方法；融合脑电与行为信号带来最大且最可靠的会话内目标检测与参与提升，基本不依赖个人技能。目标静默切换时，融合脑电的代理重新收敛比仅用行为快1.27倍，在任务变化关键时刻恢复可信指导。
papers.abstract_en: We present OLIVE, a framework for adapting a foundation model to provide real-time assistance in temporally demanding, high-stakes, and dynamic tasks. We show that passive EEG, fused online with behavioral evidence, can meaningfully extend the number of targets users detect and engage beyond their unaided action bandwidth. OLIVE learns from both explicit behavioral signals (the targets the user shoots down in an XR first-person shooter game) and implicit physiological signals (fixation-locked EEG) to provide timely guidance, continuously adapting a frozen vision-language model's inference on which items are task-relevant by jointly estimating per-source reliability without manual labels or offline training. Through three user studies, including two live deployments of an assistive agent driven by OLIVE in XR, we show that OLIVE Pareto-dominates prior test-time adaptation frameworks, achieving the highest convergence rate at comparable convergence speed. Combining implicit physiological and explicit behavioral signals, the OLIVE agent produces the largest and most reliable within-session improvement to a user's ability to detect and engage targets, largely independent of the individual's skill. When the target switches silently, the agent that uses both behavioral and physiological signals reconverges significantly faster than the behavior-only agent (1.27 times faster on average, p = .008), restoring trustworthy guidance at the moment the task changes, precisely when reliable assistance matters most.

papers.title_en: Drift Calibration in Geometric Eye Tracking Systems
papers.authors: Jiaqi Liu, Zixuan Wang, Yuhong Zhang, Dingkang Liang, Jane Hanqi Li, Tzyy-Ping Jung, Gert Cauwenberghs
papers.evidence: 明确针对眼动追踪器漂移校准，服务于基于注视的交互与多模态研究
papers.tldr: 几何眼动追踪器的测量精度受残余标定误差影响，但现有校正方法因设备和误差定义不同难以对比。为此构建了包含十二名参与者一百六十三次试验的校准数据集，并引入轻量级神经精炼器结合多种校正函数的排名预测。结果显示，后厂商校正使平均角误差从一点五三度降至一点零三度，神经精炼器进一步降至零点九六度。该工作提供了可复现的数据质量基准，有助于眼动作为交互信号的研究。
papers.abstract_en: Geometric eye trackers can provide the spatial accuracy required for gaze-based interaction and multimodal studies, but their measurements remain sensitive to residual session-specific calibration error. Research on correcting this error is difficult to compare because methods are typically evaluated with different devices, target layouts, and error definitions. We present a calibration-focused dataset containing 163 trials from 12 participants, with separate 18-point fitting and 32-point test grids, and use it to evaluate global, local, and composite correction functions under a common spatial-extrapolation protocol. We further introduce a lightweight neural refiner that combines ranked predictions from complementary calibrators. On this controlled dataset, post-vendor correction reduces the mean angular error from $1.53^\circ$ to $1.03^\circ$ with the strongest classical composite and to $0.96^\circ$ with the refiner. In a closed-loop gaze task, lower residual error is associated with higher performance across four online correction conditions. These results provide a reproducible data-quality benchmark for using gaze as a behavioral signal in interactive modeling.

papers.title_en: FocusAdapt: Context-aware Adaptive Focus Assistance in Diminished Reality
papers.authors: Tianyu Zhang, Shutong Wu, Jiankun Yang, Zhen Bai, Yukang Yan
papers.evidence: 融合注视行为预测干扰目标，实现减弱现实中的自适应焦点辅助
papers.tldr: 在增强现实中，过度移除无关物体会损失情境信息，降低态势感知。FocusAdapt提出上下文感知的消减现实系统，结合视觉显著性、语义相关性与注视行为预测物体干扰程度，并有选择地仅淡化高干扰物体，同时保留有用上下文，以实现程序性任务中的自适应焦点辅助。
papers.abstract_en: Diminished Reality (DR) can reduce visual clutter by removing irrelevant objects. However, removing all task-irrelevant objects may eliminate useful contextual information and reduce situational awareness. We present FocusAdapt, a context-aware DR system that predicts object-level distraction by integrating visual saliency, semantic relevance, and gaze behavior. Based on findings from a formative study, FocusAdapt selectively diminishes highly distracting objects while preserving useful context, enabling adaptive focus assistance during procedural tasks.

papers.title_en: Leveraging Turn-taking Dynamics for Intent Recognition in Multi-party Conversations
papers.authors: Galo Castillo-López, Alexis Lombard, Gaël de Chalendar, Nasredine Semmar
papers.evidence: 利用轮次转换动态作为辅助信号的意图识别算法
papers.tldr: 多轮对话意图识别常忽视多方交互的动态特性。本文提出多任务学习方法，引入基于说话人转换序列的转写转换熵作为辅助任务，以量化交互模式的可预测性。实验表明，该辅助目标能提升多种预训练模型的意图识别性能，优于忽略多方交互动态的现有方法。该连续目标甚至可单独作为学习任务，说明其蕴含有效信号。
papers.abstract_en: We propose a multi-task learning approach for multi-party dialogue intent recognition that leverages an auxiliary task that models turn-taking dynamics. Specifically, we introduce turn-transition entropy, a self-supervised target computed from the sequence of speaker transitions, which quantifies the predictability of interaction patterns. Experiments on multiple pre-trained models demonstrate that incorporating this auxiliary task improves intent recognition performance, outperforming existing approaches which ignore multi-party interaction dynamics. We find that our proposed continuous target can be learned as a single-task objective, suggesting that it is an actual signal carrying useful information.
